answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 500 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The trellis of the design is public, the sable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the harbor of honest work is what finally pays.
